page.content:
Latest Cretaceous Montana–Dakotas unit of T. rex and Triceratops.

How Hell Creek Formation connects

  • Item: Tyrannosaurus rex — T. rex is the apex predator of the Hell Creek Formation.
  • Item: Triceratops — Triceratops is the common large herbivore of Hell Creek.
  • Item: Sue — Sue was collected from Hell Creek beds in South Dakota.
  • Event: K–Pg extinction — Hell Creek records the K–Pg boundary that ends its dinosaurs.

What is Hell Creek Formation?

Hell Creek records the last inland-sea dinosaurs of Laramidia and the K–Pg boundary clay that ends them, the formation that produced Sue.

Key threads lead to Tyrannosaurus rex, Triceratops, Sue and K–Pg extinction.
